abstract: We present a case of a fetal pharyngeal teratoma, which was diagnosed at 21 weeks' gestation. At the time of examination, a mass of mixed echogenicity was detected that protruded through the mouth. During a second examination 3 weeks later, the tumor had increased in size, and a severe polyhydramnios had developed. Intrauterine death of the fetus was detected at 27 weeks' gestation. Labor was induced with misoprostol, and a 1,015-g stillborn female neonate was delivered. Postmortem examination confirmed the diagnosis of a pharyngeal teratoma.
abstract_ja: 胎児咽頭奇形腫の症例を提示する。妊娠21週で診断され、口から突出した混合エコー像を示す腫瘤が認められた。3週間後の再検査では腫瘍は増大し、重度の羊水過多が生じていた。妊娠27週で胎児子宮内死亡が確認された。ミソプロストールにより分娩を誘発し、体重1,015gの死産女児が娩出された。剖検により咽頭奇形腫と確定診断された。
